precedent: docs/validation-set4.md (rules, crop rule 2, judge lag); the inventory (tmp/set5-inventory.md on the main checkout) came first, as set 4's plan did

rules.same_take: waveform test (>= 80% of 20-s windows in step, median peak-to-sidelobe >= 2.0), as sets 3 and 4; every DI tested against every electric-guitar track of its session
rules.other_exclusions: a modeller (Pod/GR4) as the reference; an amp track that belongs to another DI
rules.reference_choice: set 4's AMP_PREFERENCE among the amp tracks the names declare; else the passing track
rules.split: every band held out: no draw, no folds

scope.rule: a part's session-level gain_class: clean and crunch parts are in scope; high-gain parts are reported, never counted in a set-5 decision (docs/ROADMAP scope: no heavy metal)

rules.crop: crop rule 2 ('di-activity'), 10 s, 48 kHz mono, docs/validation-datasets.md
rules.lag_sign: positive when the amp track is later than the DI
rules.band_weighting: recommended as set 3's amendment (4): each band's parts weigh 1/n; a confirmation plan adopts or overrides it explicitly
